regions.region: page 7 full-page Scheme 8 natural-product structure inventory
regions.finding: Scheme 8 is a molecular inventory of naturally occurring 2-oxygenated carbazole alkaloids, not a reaction scheme. The structures were visually inspected and no experiment was fabricated from the inventory.

regions.region: page 7 lower-left continuation of the page-6 clauszoline-K paragraph
regions.finding: The sentence completes the 11d-to-clauszoline-K transformation with potassium hydride, t-BuLi, and DMF; Scheme 13 on page 10 supplies the paired room-temperature and -40 °C stages plus 54% yield. The page-6 incomplete record was enriched rather than duplicated.

regions.region: page 7 lower text on clausine C, 3-formyl-7-hydroxycarbazole, clausine-M, and route yields
regions.finding: Three cited transformations were linked to Scheme 13 records, and five route-level overall yields were added to the existing methoxypropadiene summary without assigning them to final steps.

unresolved: Scheme 8 compound structures are not reaction records and remain outside machine structure verification.
The route summaries omit many stage-specific quantities and operational details.

regions.finding: Scheme 9 is a retrosynthetic analysis with generic R3/R4 groups and is classified as planning context, not a performed experiment.

regions.region: page 8 center Scheme 10 synthesis of siamenol
regions.finding: Seven displayed arrows/operations were reconciled with page-6 narrative records: allenol formation, AuCl cyclization, bromination, oxidative debenzylation, BBr3 demethylation, acetate protection, and the two-stage one-pot prenyl coupling/deprotection. Stage yields, loadings, temperatures, and times were structured without assigning the 66% sequence yield to one stage.

regions.region: page 8 lower text introducing gram-scale synthesis and large-scale 3e
regions.finding: The 60 mmol/15.9 g substrate, 2 mol% AuCl, 8.0 g molecular sieves, 17.4 g product, 91% isolated yield, and recrystallization were linked to the ordered Scheme 14 record on page 10.
The monobromination discussion continues on page 9 and is represented once as Equation 2 with cross-page evidence.

unresolved: Scheme 10 omits most absolute quantities and yield bases.
The page-6 bromination sentence names 1a while Scheme 10 depicts 3a.
Scheme 14 omits solvent volumes and atmosphere.

regions.finding: The route was split by arrows: a combined 6b-to-3b two-step run (77%), 3b bromination (93%), 7b oxidative debenzylation (81%), and five downstream 8b/isomukonidine/clausine-L/glycosinine transformations. Combined and stage yields remain distinct.
The 6c-to-3c sequence retains the printed 74% combined yield across allenol formation and cyclization; the separate 3c-to-clausine-V oxidative debenzylation is 83%.

regions.region: page 9 lower monobromination text and Equation 2
regions.finding: A distinct 24 mmol gram-scale run uses 7.6 g 3e, 0.92 equiv NBS in CHCl3 at -20 °C and gives 7e 6.5 g/16.3 mmol/68% plus dibromide 12 in a 95:5 NMR ratio.

unresolved: Most Scheme 11/12 arrows omit scale, workup, purification, isolated mass, and yield basis.
Several low-temperature additions and ramps have no printed duration.

regions.finding: Nine displayed transformations were reconciled with page-6/7 records or added: 6d-to-1d, AuCl cyclization, debenzylation, 11d formylation/carboxylation, methylation, and two BBr3 demethylations. Each arrow retains its own yield and temperature program.

One ordered, multi-stage 60 mmol experiment was built with 20 min n-BuLi addition at -40 °C, 40 min hold, 25 min aldehyde addition, a 1.5 h -40 °C-to-room-temperature transition, then AuCl/4 Å MS cyclization at 25 °C for 11 h. The 17.4 g/91% value is retained as the overall isolated result to 3e.
The text gives stage yields for 7e-to-8e, two 8e branches, clausine-O, and clausine-H; these are linked to the mass/amount-rich Scheme 15 records on page 11.

regions.region: page 10 lower-right Scheme 16 and Scheme 17 introductions
regions.finding: The two selective AlCl3 demethylations are linked to Scheme 16 records; the Scheme 17 discussion is retrosynthetic strategy rather than a performed experiment.

unresolved: Most Scheme 13 arrows lack absolute scale and yield basis.
Some Scheme 15/16 stage times and reagent quantities are omitted.

regions.finding: Five gram-scale transformations were recorded with printed starting/product masses and amounts, stage yields, reagent sets, the 35 min room-temperature KH stage, and the 30 min -78 °C-to--30 °C warming transition. Branches from 8e remain independent experiments.

Two independent AlCl3/CH2Cl2 demethylations from different substrates were retained separately with -5 °C-to-room-temperature programs, product masses/amounts, 94%/92% yields, and single-product outcomes.

regions.region: page 11 lower text and Scheme 17 strategy discussion
regions.finding: The Knoevenagel/electrocyclization and decarboxylative-allylation descriptions introduce later cited routes; Scheme 17 itself is retrosynthetic analysis and is not represented as a performed experiment.

regions.region: page 11 right-column beginning of carbazole 15 synthesis
regions.finding: The prose begins the five-step 6b-to-15 route shown with complete conditions on page 12; records use cross-page evidence and keep it distinct from Scheme 11's different 5 mol%/77% 6b-to-3b experiment.

unresolved: Scheme 15/16 omit several reagent quantities, workups, and purifications.
Scheme 17 is planning context with generic FG and no experiment-specific yield.

regions.finding: Scheme 17 is retrosynthetic analysis with generic FG = CH3 or CHO. It was inspected as planning context and not converted into experimental arrows.

Three condition-distinct experiments were retained: combined 6b-to-3b (89%), NBS bromination (94%), and n-BuLi/MeI conversion to 15 (92%). The five-step 78% overall yield from 6b is a separate route-level summary, not the last-step yield.

Four independent stages were recorded with their reagents, equivalents, ordered temperature programs, stage yields, and masses. The printed 58%/54% values remain overall route yields from 6b in a separate summary.

Three partial cited transformations were retained from the visible narrative: two-operation formation of 13a in qualitative excellent yield, Pd(PPh3)4-catalyzed formation of ether 18 with missing partner details, and Claisen rearrangement to mukoenine-A in qualitative high yield. The heptaphylline sentence continues beyond page 12 and was not completed from unclaimed pages.

unresolved: The 13a/18/mukoenine-A narrative omits most quantities and gives only qualitative yield wording for two transformations.
The heptaphylline procedure continues on page 13 and was not imported or claimed as covered.
